name: Renbrook School Summer Adventure
description_short: A day camp at Renbrook School in West Hartford for children age 3 through Grade 9, led by teachers and educators. Summer 2027 runs June 14 to July 30: a one-week Pre-Season Camp (June 14-17), then three two-week sessions. Registration for 2027 is open.
refund_policy_summary: Each session includes a non-refundable $75 registration fee. The rest of tuition is refundable until May 1, 2027, when payment in full is due.
swim_waterfront_notes: All campers swim every day. Lessons follow the American Red Cross Learn to Swim program at about one staff member per four campers, with a placement test on day one. Three fenced pools (two 2.5 feet deep, one 3.5 to 8 feet) each have a Red Cross lifeguard on duty; floaties are not allowed.
